resolved_conflicts.explanation: Left open: the register puts this record in Mifflin County, while the Forest Lookouts pages file a Buck Ridge tree observation point, dated before 1918, under Cumberland County. The sources do not show whether these are one early lookout with a county error or two sites. The story keeps the register's Mifflin County record and does not treat the Cumberland listing as this site.

notes_for_editor: Two Forest Lookouts pages (buck-ridge.html and the Pennsylvania A-F index) put Buck Ridge in Cumberland County, not Mifflin. The Cumberland register record (US 229) is a Blaw-Knox tower built in 1934; its existing research file says the Staley's Knob entry dates the move to 1934, while the register page says the 1970s. Those two should be reconciled. Brief coordinates (40.69646, -77.70055) are not on the register and could not be checked, because the gazetteer returned 403, so they are not in the story. One search surfaced a standing 'Buck Ridge Tower' summit in Cumberland County (TopoQuest, Mapcarta); I did not verify that it is the Cumberland register record. Brief kind 'unknown' could read 'tree' per the register. No staffing, fire or access source was found.
